# Quran Academy

> Premier online Quran learning academy providing 1-on-1 live classes with certified male and female Qaris and Qariahs.

## Overview
Quran Academy is an international online educational platform dedicated to teaching Quran recitation, Tajweed, Memorisation (Hifz), Islamic Studies, and Arabic language to children and adults worldwide. Classes are conducted via a custom, low-latency live interactive classroom equipped with synchronized mushaf cursors, tajweed audio guides, and teacher video/audio.

## Key Programmes
- **Noorani & Madani Qaida Foundation**: Beginners level course for children and adults to master Arabic alphabet pronunciation and joining letters.
- **Tajweed & Fluent Recitation**: Comprehensive rules of Tajweed (Makharij, Ghunnah, Ikhfa, Idgham, Qalqalah) with applied practice.
- **Quran Memorisation (Hifz al-Quran)**: Structured revision and new lesson schedules (Sabaq, Sabaqi, Manzil) with personalized teacher pacing.
- **Islamic Studies & Duas for Kids**: Daily prayers, Sunnah etiquettes, Islamic history, and moral character development.
- **Quranic Arabic & Translation**: Understanding the vocabulary and grammar of the Holy Quran.

## Key Features
- **Live 1-on-1 Sessions**: 30-minute or 60-minute interactive classes tailored to the student's individual learning speed.
- **Certified & Vetted Instructors**: Verified Ijaza holders, Qaris, and Alims/Alimahs fluent in English, Urdu, and Arabic.
- **Interactive Web Classroom**: Sub-500ms real-time audio/video classroom with word-by-word Quran practice players, live highlight pointers, and recording archives.
- **Parent & Student Portals**: Detailed lesson notes after every class, attendance logs, monthly performance reports, and downloadable PDF progress records.
- **Flexible Scheduling**: Available 24/7 across US, UK, Canada, Australia, and European timezones.
- **Free Trial**: 30-minute free evaluation class with zero payment obligation.
